scripts.build:libs: ng build tool-dom && ng build tool-exchange && ng build tool-width-page && ng build tool-config-to-lib
scripts.dev: concurrently "ng build tool-dom --watch" "ng build tool-exchange --watch" "ng build tool-width-page --watch" "ng build tool-config-to-lib --watch" "ng serve --open"
scripts.publish:dom: cd projects/tool-dom && git push --follow-tags && cd ../.. && ng build tool-dom && cd dist/tool-dom && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:dom:patch: npm run ver:dom:patch && npm run publish:dom
scripts.release:dom:minor: npm run ver:dom:minor && npm run publish:dom
scripts.release:dom:major: npm run ver:dom:major && npm run publish:dom

scripts.release:exchange:patch: npm run ver:exchange:patch && npm run publish:exchange

scripts.release:exchange:major: npm run ver:exchange:major && npm run publish:exchange
